column3: Ayase Route ・ Interlude
After finishing my bath, I noticed my little sister on the phone in the living room.
Ahahaha, seriously? Like really?
...Eh? Ayase, what did you just say?
Akiba? You and I?
Eh? Eh? Why? Where did that come from anyway?
No, um... Well... I... don't mind.
...How did this happen?
Seems like she's on the phone with Ayase.
Yeah, yeah... Alright. Gotcha.
Uu...
What are you groaning about? The bath's free.
Oh, shut up.
Well, for some reason Ayase asked me to go to Akiba with her.
O-Oh, yeah?
I mean, this is Ayase we're talking about... Weird, isn't it?
That's what I thought as late as this morning.
It's kind of scary. I feel like there's something more to it... What do you think?
I-I don't know.
This girl's saying some nasty things about her own friend.
I guess Ayase wants to see the fruits of her efforts.
I just hope this goes well.
Oh yeah, where did you go today?
Eh?!
W-W-Why do I have to tell you?
...Why are you freaking out? I was just asking.
W-Well... It's just...
Hmm... So you've been to some place you can't tell me about.
Just... somewhere in Akiba.
Hmm?
Hmmmmmmm?
W-What?
Nothing, really.
W-Well, see you later then.
I went to Akiba to get a 【H-Game】!
Wait, really?!
Yeah! I pre-ordered "Lovely Little Sisters Paradise" first-press special phone-card edition! Got a problem with that?!?
N-Not really! You don't have to snap like that...
I'll lend it to you once I've finished it! Fuahaha, see ya!
...Alright, score.
Phew, that was close.
If Kirino knew I went to Akiba with Ayase... I can't even imagine what would happen...
My phone... Oh, it's Ayase?
Good evening, Onii-san.
Y-Yeah, good evening.
You're going to Akiba with Kirino?
Y-Yes...
Are you sure? Just the two of you? Want me to come along, just in case?
It will be fine. I'll manage.
O-Okay.
Besides, hehe... Kirino and I are going out; why would you want to come along, Onii-san?
...You might have a point there.
Hehe.
She's laughing at me.
W-Well... Good luck.
Yes.
...This silence...
W-Well(U-Umm!)...
Oh.
I-I'm sorry. Go ahead.
N-Nah, it's nothing important. You go first.
O-Okay. Well...
Onii-san, regarding 【Summer Comiket】...
【Summer Comiket】?
Never thought she'd bring that up.
Saori-san mentioned it today, that Kirino has this 'festival' she's looking forward to.
Yeah. Though during summer last year, you and Kirino met there by chance and you ended up quarreling.
That was on the way home from 【Summer Comiket】.
...I'm sorry. In the end, I just can't be friends with people like that.
I said some... really mean things to Kirino.
Well, that's all in the past now.
Now she's all quiet again...
I think I can kind of see why Ayase wants to understand Kirino's hobby...
The anxiety of not understanding what Kirino is so passionate about.
The anxiety of having Kirino stolen away from her by like-minded friends.
Being unable to understand and instead rejecting what's important to Kirino...
She simply doesn't know what to do, but she knows she has to do something about it.
...She wants to do something about it.
Onii-san, I... am considering going to 【Summer Comiket】.
Eh?
But... you wouldn't be able to enjoy yourself there.
Still...
I want to see for myself... what I was rejecting without knowing about it.
She's already made up her mind, huh.
Well, in that case... I guess I'll tag along.
...Really? But aren't you busy preparing for the entrance exam, Onii-san?
Don't worry, my grades are actually pretty good.
You're going with Kirino and Saori-san, aren't you?
Nah, they didn't invite me. Wonder what they're doing this year.
So yeah, it's up to you.
Onii-san, I...
Ayase... Want to go to 【Summer Comiket】?
Eh?
Let me say this first though, you probably won't enjoy it.
I can say that because I've been there. It's hot, tiring and... There's just nothing good about it.
Still, if you would like... want to go have a look together?
...It's not like I think this'll cure her otaku-phobia.
In fact, it might have the opposite effect.
But since it's her, she'll definitely do something.
If left to her own devices, she'd definitely go on a rampage, find that nothing she does makes a difference and getting all hurt by herself...
In that case, I'll just have to follow her and we'll do all that together instead.
How about it, Ayase?
...Really? But aren't you busy preparing for the entrance exam, Onii-san?
Don't worry, my grades are actually pretty good.
You're going with Kirino and Saori-san, aren't you?
Nah, they didn't invite me. Wonder what they're doing this year.
So yeah, it's up to you.
Onii-san, I...
I'm counting on you.
Alright then.
With that, Ayase and I decided to go together to this year's Summer Comiket.
Oh yeah, should I check with Saori? It might be reassuring for you to have her around.
N-No, that's...
Hmm?
If possible, why don't we go just the two of us?
Yeah? Alright. We'll go just the two of us.
Okay. I'm counting on you then, Onii-san.
